<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\{Order, Product, Category, User, Review};

class BenchmarkBeforeAIController extends Controller
{
    # Before 
        public function orders()
    {
        return Order::all()->map(fn ($o) => [
            'id' => $o->id,
            'user' => $o->user->name,
            'items_count' => $o->items->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function orderShow(Order $order)
    {
        return [
            'id' => $order->id,
            'user' => $order->user->name,
            'items' => $order->items->map(fn ($item) => [
                'product' => $item->product->label,
            ]),
        ];
    }

    public function enterpriseOrder()
    {
        $order = Order::where('number', 'ENT-00001')->firstOrFail();
        return [
            'id' => $order->id,
            'items' => $order->items->map(fn ($item) => [
                'product' => $item->product->label,
            ]),
        ];
    }

    public function products()
    {
        return Product::all()->map(fn ($p) => [
            'label' => $p->label,
            'category' => optional($p->category)->label,
        ]);
    }

    public function productsByCategory(Category $category)
    {
        return Product::where('category_id', $category->id)->get();
    }

    public function productReviews(Product $product)
    {
        return $product->reviews->map(fn ($r) => [
            'rating' => $r->rating,
            'user' => $r->user->name,
        ]);
    }

    public function productsWithoutCategory()
    {
        return Product::whereNull('category_id')->get();
    }

    public function categoryProducts(Category $category)
    {
        return $category->products->map(fn ($p) => [
            'label' => $p->label,
            'reviews_count' => $p->reviews->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function userOrders(User $user)
    {
        return $user->orders->map(fn ($o) => [
            'number' => $o->number,
            'items_count' => $o->items->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function recentReviews()
    {
        return Review::latest()->take(20)->get()->map(fn ($r) => [
            'product' => $r->product->label,
            'user' => $r->user->name,
        ]);
    }
}

2. `orderShow(Order $order)`: single order, accesses `$order->user->name` (lazy loads user - 1 extra query, but not N+1 per se; still it's a lazy load). Accesses `$order->items->map(...)` and each item's `product`. This is N+1: items loaded lazily (1 query), then each item's product loads (N queries). Fix: `$order->load(['user', 'items.product'])`.

3. `enterpriseOrder()`: single order, items then each product. N+1 on product per item. Fix: `Order::where(...)->with('items.product')->firstOrFail()`.

4. `products()`: Product::all(), then each product's category. N+1 on category. Fix: `Product::with('category')->get()`.

5. `productsByCategory(Category $category)`: `Product::where('category_id', $category->id)->get()` - no relations accessed. No N+1.

6. `productReviews(Product $product)`: `$product->reviews->map(...)` then each review's user. N+1 on user per review. Fix: `$product->load('reviews.user')` or `$product->reviews()->with('user')->get()`.

8. `categoryProducts(Category $category)`: `$category->products->map(...)` then each product's reviews count. N+1 on reviews per product.
